scope: This binds directly to fast-ecdlp commit d1deb5abe008e981206ed58cbd83012b6afc3740 and its DilationNondeg definition. It does not construct the specialized Semaev family or prove its nonvanishing and vanishing laws.
statement: For a finite field K, a tuple-indexed family of nonzero polynomials of degree at most D that vanishes at u^(-2) on every bad dilation in Kaarelson pinned predicate proves the exact upstream ECDLP.L49.DilationNondeg bound of at most 2D bad units.
